title: Ordinal enumeration of a given well-ordered set
statement: Let $E$ be a set and $<$ a strict well-order on $E$: it is a strict total order for which every nonempty subset has a least element, the well-order notion of [lem-weil-pbc-well-ordering-theorem]. Then there exist a set ordinal $\kappa$ and a bijection $\eta:\{\beta:\beta<\kappa\}\to E$ such that for all $\beta,\gamma<\kappa$ one has $\eta(\beta)<\eta(\gamma)$ if and only if $\beta<\gamma$. The order $<$ on the domain is the usual ordinal order.
